display_name: Example Campaign (template - copy this file and edit it for a real campaign)

hook.notes: The clipper builds the hook from the words around the clip's peak moment. Read it in the clip JSON / post pack and check it reads clean before posting, or re-render with --hook to set it exactly.

name: example-campaign
post_notes: Write the caption in your own words, fresh for every clip. Never copy a campaign brief's example captions word for word.
Use ONLY the footage the campaign supplies. Clips from any other source will not be paid.
Post the clip, then submit its link to the campaign immediately after posting.
Keep the post up for the period the campaign requires, with likes visible.
No paid ads, no boosts, no bots.
Manual posting only - this tool never posts, submits or uploads anything.
rules_notes: This is a TEMPLATE profile. Before using it for a real campaign, read that campaign's rules off its own page and replace every value in this file: length limits, platform, required caption line, watermark, and notes.
Re-check the campaign is still live, with budget left, on the day you clip. Campaigns close.
Never guess another campaign's rules from this example.
